intention: Any user can sign in with Google, connect their own Tesla, and monitor their vehicles.

status_legend.proposed: OpenSpec change created (proposal/design/specs/tasks) and validated; not yet implemented.

token_tracking: Manual — an assistant cannot reliably self-measure its own token use; fill from your CLI usage/cost display (e.g. Claude Code /cost). null = not tracked.

Archived 2026-07-07. Google login via golang.org/x/oauth2 + google endpoint (no managed auth — VPS cost). internal/googleauth adapter (Identity from userinfo). Routes /login, /auth/google/{login,callback}, POST /logout. Identity (uid+email) kept in the encrypted session cookie — no per-request DB read, no new account method. CSRF via state in session. Config GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/SECRET + BASE_URL. 8 gateway tests pass (incl. redirect-with-state, mismatched-state 400, anon sign-in). build/vet/test green (go 1.26.4). Delta synced into specs/gateway. Google OAuth setup documented in docs/deployment.md.
